subject: Exec retreat AV + satellite rooms: sync on audio zoning and conference failover
messages:
From: Rebecca Jennings <rjennings@acme.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Weller <tweller@catalystconf.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T16:12:00Z
Subject: Exec retreat AV/room plan: main + satellite breakout sync

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for coordinating. Attached are the latest site drawings for the Acme HQ West campus (acme-site-drawings_v2.pdf). We have a 2‑day exec retreat the week of Nov 9 — 28 people in the main boardroom, and three satellite breakout rooms (10/8/8). The execs will dial in from Europe for the Monday morning session (11/9) and from APAC for Tuesday afternoon (11/10).

Priority items for us:
- Clear audio zoning so the remote participants only hear the main table when necessary (we need per-zone mute control).
- Failover for the primary conferencing bridge (we have a preference for a second SIP trunk or an on-site codec).
- Minimal on-stage tech footprint for the main boardroom (discreet mics, ceiling samples preferred).

Can Redwood provide a recommended configuration and confirm whether Catalyst can handle bridging + codec failover? Also we need an estimated lead time for any special hardware.

Thanks — Rebecca
Rebecca Jennings
Director, Events & Workplace Experience
Acme Corp

Date: 2026-10-29T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec retreat AV/room plan: main + satellite breakout sync

Rebecca — thanks for the drawings and the headcount. I skimmed the site plan; below is a high-level proposal from Redwood events + ops before Monica drops into technical detail: 

Proposed topology (high level):
- Main boardroom: 28 seats, single central table + two presentation screens (left/right). Ceiling mic array (beamforming) for table capture, plus 4 boundary mics at head positions for redundancy.
- Satellite rooms A/B/C: tabletop speakerphone (PoE) + wall display for slides, local projection where needed.
- Network: dedicate VLAN for AV with QoS and redundant 1Gb uplink to Catalyst bridge appliance.
- Failover: primary SIP trunk to Acme UC; secondary codec on-site that can take the session if the trunk degrades. Catalyst to provide bridge failover and codec staging.

Operational asks from Acme:
1) Confirm whether any participants need interpreter channels.
2) Confirm preferred time windows in local PST for rehearsals (we should do one dry run with EU and one with APAC).

I'll hand off the detailed AV spec to Monica (she's authored the attachable XLS spec). Markus will coordinate Catalyst logistics and load-in windows. Laura will own guest arrival / VIP brief.

Next steps: Monica to post recommended mic counts, codec models, and an attachment with line item failover runbook.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager, Field Events
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-30T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec retreat AV/room plan: main + satellite breakout sync

Rebecca / team — attaching the detailed AV spec (redwood-av-spec_v1.xlsx) and Catalyst's initial bridge quote (catalyst-bridge-quote.pdf). Highlights from the spec:

1) Audio zoning and control
- Main room divided into three audio zones: table, presenter/lectern, and gallery (observer seats). Each zone has independent mute and gain control surfaced in the Redwood event operator UI.
- Ceiling beamforming array (recommended Shure MXA910) for table capture with redundant SHURE MXA310 for heads-up fallback.
- Dante-enabled DSP to handle local mixing and per-zone send/receive to the bridge.

2) Conferencing failover and bridging
- Primary: Catalyst cloud bridge via SIP trunk to Acme UC.
- Secondary: On-site codec (Poly G7500 or equivalent) set to automatically answer a monitored dial; RTP monitoring triggers switch after 3 packet-loss spikes >5% or one 5-second silence.
- Parallel recording: local NVR capture to a removable SSD for audit.

3) Breakouts
- Each satellite gets a PoE speakerphone (Konftel C5070) wired to a room-level AV endpoint; room-level mutes propagated to main bridge when presenter link is active to avoid echo.

4) Bandwidth and QoS
- Reserve 4 Mbps uplink for the main room and 1 Mbps per breakout during peak. Catalyst to test repeaters during load-in.

5) Onsite roles and runbook
- Redwood Tech Lead: Monica Patel (onsite contact)
- Catalyst Lead: Tom Weller
- Onsite schedule: load-in on Nov 8 (08:00–18:00), tech rehearsal Nov 9 (06:00–08:30 PT for EU call), dress rehearsal Nov 10 (12:00–13:30 PT for APAC loop).

Attachments include line-item equipment, spec references, and the failover decision tree. If Acme confirms the model approvals I can generate a PO-ready quote.

- Monica
Monica Patel
Events Technical Lead, Redwood Inference

Quick logistics update from Catalyst side (cc Tom):

Tom — per Monica's spec we can provision the on-site Poly G7500 as the hot-swap codec and stage a second SIP trunk on a portable edge router. We'll bring two managed switches configured for the AV VLAN and a redundant 1Gb uplink via cellular failover as an extra contingency. Load-in ETA: Nov 8 08:30 local; full inventory + test by 14:00.

Rebecca / Karthik — please confirm gate access for the Catalyst truck (gates 3 or 5?), and whether Acme facilities will provide an ethernet punch-down in the main boardroom marked on the drawing. Also confirm whether any of the seat assignments are VIPs requiring lapel mic sets (we budgeted 6 lapels as optional).

Markus Klein
Logistics Lead, Catalyst Conferences (on contract)

Subject: Re: Exec retreat AV/room plan: main + satellite breakout sync

Thanks all — confirming gate 5 for truck access and Acme facilities will have the ethernet punch-down ready at the marked location; I'll send badge passes by EOD Nov 4. Lapel mics: yes, please include 4 wired lapels and 2 wireless as the optional 6 you budgeted.

We reviewed the spec and are happy to proceed with the on-site codec failover and Catalyst provisioned bridge. Please produce final PO-ready quote (line items + ship-by dates) by Nov 4 so procurement can issue the PO same day.

Rebecca
Rebecca Jennings
Director, Events & Workplace Experience
Acme Corp
